package monitor // import "ubunatic.com/loom/examples/monitor/monitor"

Package monitor is experimental; its API may change between releases. See
docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

Package monitor prints the embedded static shell once, without opening a TTY.

FUNCTIONS

func Execute(ctx context.Context, args []string, out io.Writer) error
    Execute runs the monitor example's cobra command against ctx/args/out,
    for callers that need explicit context and output control (e.g. tests).

func NewWidget(args []string) (loom.Widget, error)
    NewWidget parses monitor flags and constructs the corresponding root widget.

func NewWidgetFromOptions(opts Options) (loom.Widget, error)
    NewWidgetFromOptions constructs the declaration-backed monitor widget.

func Run(args []string) error
    Run runs the monitor example with the given command-line args, writing to
    stdout, matching the Run(args []string) error signature shared by the other
    examples for loom-demo/loom-bench registration.


TYPES

type Options struct {
	Watch bool
	Width int
}
    Options configures the standalone command and hosted monitor widget.
